MMM Social Workers & Associates provides compassionate, confidential and evidence-based counselling services for individuals, families, couples and organisations across Midrand, Johannesburg, Centurion, and online.

Our Mission: To empower individuals, families and communities through compassionate, ethical and evidence-based social work services.

Our Vision: To become a trusted leader in professional social work by promoting wellbeing, resilience and positive social change.

Our Values: Integrity, compassion, respect, confidentiality and professionalism guide everything we do.

MMM Social Workers & Associates is committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA).

Information collected through this app (your name, email, phone number, and booking details) is used solely to manage your appointments with the practice, and is not shared with third parties beyond what is necessary to provide this service.

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time via the Settings screen or by contacting the practice directly.

These Terms and Conditions apply to your use of the MMM Social Workers & Associates booking app. By registering or making a booking you agree to them.

1. ACCEPTANCE AND USE OF THE APP
You must give accurate information when you register and book. You are responsible for keeping your login details private and for everything done on your account. The app is a booking tool only. It is not an emergency or crisis service: in a crisis, use the emergency contact details on the Contact screen.

2. BOOKINGS
A booking made in the app is a request. It is only confirmed once MMM Social Workers & Associates confirms it, and you can follow its status in My Bookings. Appointments can only be requested on the practice's open days, within opening hours, and for times the app shows as free. The practice may decline or reschedule a request if necessary.

3. CANCELLATION
You may cancel a booking in the app up to 24 hours before the appointment, free of charge. Within 24 hours of the appointment, cancelling in the app is closed: please phone or WhatsApp the practice as early as possible. A late cancellation (less than 24 hours' notice) may be charged as a full or partial session fee at the practice's discretion. Cancelling in the app is permanent. To change your appointment time, cancel with enough notice and make a new booking.

4. NO-SHOWS AND LATE ARRIVAL
If you do not attend an appointment and have not cancelled it, it is treated as a no-show and may be charged as a full session fee. If you arrive late, your session still ends at the scheduled time and the full fee may apply. Repeated no-shows may lead to the practice declining future bookings.

5. FEES AND PAYMENT ARRANGEMENTS
Session fees vary by service. The practice sends you a fee quotation before your appointment is confirmed. Payment is arranged directly with the practice. The app does not process payments, and it does not create video-consultation links: online sessions are arranged directly with the practice. The Paid status in the app is recorded by the practice. Any late-cancellation or no-show fee is the amount quoted or agreed with the practice.

6. ACCEPTABLE USE
You may not use another person's account or details, give false information, make bookings you do not intend to keep, try to access other users' information or interfere with the app or its security, or use the app in any unlawful way or to abuse staff or other clients. The practice may suspend or remove an account that breaks these terms.

7. PRIVACY
Your personal information is handled as described in the Privacy Policy, in line with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

8. CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
The practice may update these terms. The version shown in the app is the current one.

9. CONTACT
For questions about these terms, bookings or fees, use the Contact screen to phone, email or WhatsApp the practice.
